item.title: What Your Poop Says About Your Heart Health
item.description: Discover the surprising link between gut health and your heart, how chronic constipation increases cardiovascular risk, and tips to improve your heart health.

item.title: Is Corn Keto?
item.description: Learn how many grams of carbohydrates corn has and whether this healthy food can fit easily into a ketogenic diet or other low-carb diets.

item.title: What Do Olympic Athletes Eat, and Are Their Diets Healthy?
item.description: Generally, yes! But that doesn’t mean pros like Lindsey Vonn, Chloe Kim, and Mia Manganello don’t indulge every now and then. Here’s what registered dietitian-nutritionists want you to learn from Olympians' diet habits.

item.title: What Is ANCA-Associated Vasculitis (AAV)?
item.description: ANCA-associated vasculitis (AAV) is a group of rare autoimmune diseases that cause inflammation of small blood vessels. Learn about symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment.

item.title: How Often Should You Shower?
item.description: There's no single answer for optimal shower frequency. Experts explain how skin type, lifestyle, and climate affect how often you should shower, and the right way to do it.

item.title: How Do You Get Tested for Hepatitis C?
item.description: Several testing procedures are available, from blood tests to imaging, to accurately diagnose hepatitis C infection.

item.title: Can the Keto Diet Help Treat Depression?
item.description: For people with depression who aren’t getting adequate relief from medication, new research suggests a high-fat, low-carb diet may help.

item.title: Is Moderate Drinking Good or Bad for You?
item.description: Studies have shown that moderate drinking can impact health in numerous ways. So is it safe or not? Experts weigh in.

item.title: GPA vs. MPA vs. EGPA: A Guide to Your Specific ANCA Vasculitis Subtype
item.description: Navigate the complexities of ANCA-associated vasculitis subtypes with our guide to GPA, MPA, and EGPA. Learn symptoms, diagnosis, and treatments for these subtypes.

item.title: Can These 8 Home Remedies Really Help Herpes?
item.description: Learn what scientific research and experts say about the evidence for common home remedies for herpes, including honey, lemon balm, and petroleum jelly.
